newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Somague to buy part of A.Silva-sources.
newsitem.headline: Somague to buy part of A.Silva-sources.

text.p: Portuguese construction firm Somague plans to buy part of the A.Silva e Silva construction group, a source involved in the process said.
"Somague is buying part of the A.Silva e Silva group," the source told Reuters.
Shares in both companies were suspended by the Financial Markets Committee (CMVM) today.
"The CMVM is awaiting clarification from the two companies," an official source of the CMVM said.
Officials of the two companies were not immediately available.
A.Silva e Silva closed on Lisbon bourse yesterday at 1,740 escudos and Somague at 2.100, the high for 1997.
